For a G-fixed point every positively weighted target orbit determines a unique G-equivariant map to the transitive source. Its stabilizer-fixed point count is exact. Equal source-fiber size |O|/m produces a bijective piecewise-affine normalization with the finite-set join, including boundary faces; inverse formulas and integer sphere ranks follow. The independent verifier confirms orbit assignments for S3 and S4; the universal proof is symbolic.
